title: night_settings/v1
description: Settings of one unattended night at .baltor/night/settings.json, written by a person. plan-night-queue reads the budget keys, night-preflight reads the budget, test and guard keys, and record-blocker reads one_ticket_per_harness. plan-night-queue and night-preflight refuse unknown keys.

model_calls.description: Model calls the night may make.

reserve_percent.description: Share of both budgets kept back. The rest is the usable budget.

hold_high_risk.description: When true, high-risk tickets are held out of the night.

one_ticket_per_harness.description: When true, each ticket runs in its own freshly started harness: record-blocker never starts the next ticket, the host does. When false, one session works through the queue and record-blocker starts the next ticket.

test_command.description: The test command as a list of arguments. night-preflight runs it from the workspace root without a shell.

guard_files.description: Workspace paths of hook or permission files that night-preflight checks for guard rules.
